purpose: SHA-bound diagnosis of the 34 Control Hipico source/pre-QA failures observed on the ticket baseline. A changed-on-PR row is not PASS until the exact current candidate is re-executed.
verificationPolicy: All rows remain PENDING_EXACT_REVERIFY until source tests and dependent gates execute on the exact final candidate SHA. Static review or a different Vercel SHA cannot promote these rows to PASS.

failures.testName: chat import is allowed only when every new pair matches active track and race number
failures.actual: AMBIGUOUS
failures.decision: The parser/import guard now requires race date in addition to track and race number. Keep the stricter three-part race identity and update the fixture instead of weakening the guard.

failures.testName: incomplete race context requires explicit manual confirmation path
failures.expected: copy matching 'no tienen hipódromo y número de carrera'
failures.actual: copy says 'no tienen fecha, hipódromo y número de carrera verificables'
failures.decision: The new copy correctly exposes the additional date requirement. Preserve the safer wording and align the assertion with the complete race identity.

failures.testName: already imported pairs are excluded from active-race decisions
failures.actual: AMBIGUOUS
failures.decision: The remaining new pair lacked complete dated race context. Keep fail-closed matching and update the fixture to provide date, track and race number.

failures.testName: hipico loads one canonical visual authority
failures.actual: app.css plus mobile-accessibility.css, operational-copy-center.css and operational-access-guard.css
failures.decision: The historical single-file assertion conflicts with the current layered architecture. app.css remains global authority while bounded accessibility/operational layers own isolated concerns; tests and guide must describe that same authority model.

failures.testName: canonical style guide owns PWA/APK, touch and responsive QA rules
failures.expected: Style Guide contains an explicit 44 px touch-target contract
failures.actual: Style Guide described responsive/accessibility behavior without the literal 44 px contract
failures.decision: The runtime already enforces 44px touch targets, but the canonical guide omitted the measurable requirement. Document the exact target and keep it synchronized with mobile QA.

failures.testName: EPIC #102 implementation inventory is materially present
failures.actual: components.css does not exist
failures.decision: The handoff inventory referenced an obsolete parallel CSS authority. Remove that stale inventory requirement and point the EPIC handoff to the canonical layered CSS set actually shipped.

failures.testName: #106 keeps the legacy whatsapp facade connected to the extracted parser service
failures.expected: legacy fixture has requiresApproval=false, needsReview=false and no dated race context
failures.actual: parser adds raceDate/raceContext and marks incomplete context requiresApproval=true and needsReview=true
failures.decision: The extracted parser gained a stricter dated race-context contract. Keep the fail-closed behavior and compare the facade against the current parser output rather than the pre-hardening snapshot.

failures.testName: #106 parser remains pure/testable and facade remains intentionally small
failures.actual: heuristic reports 'la fachada no debe volver a concentrar el parser'
failures.decision: A raw source-size heuristic no longer proves ownership after safety adapters were added. Verify delegation to the extracted parser and absence of duplicate parser implementation instead.

failures.testName: Meta webhook verifies raw signature and signed envelope identity before extraction or persistence
failures.expected: textual helper indexes appear in one historical source order
failures.actual: semantic helpers were extracted/reordered so the global source-index ordering assertion is false
failures.decision: Keep the signature/envelope/persistence ordering guarantee but assert it within the webhook handler/owned calls rather than across helper declaration positions.

failures.testName: Meta webhook partitions malformed message identities instead of dropping valid signed siblings
failures.expected: partition, invalid count, phone binding, persistence and partial ack appear in historical textual index order
failures.actual: source-index ordering assertion is false after helper extraction/refactor
failures.decision: Preserve sibling partition behavior and partial acknowledgement semantics; test handler flow/behavior rather than declaration order in the file.

failures.testName: serverless adapter capture remains evidence-only and non-authoritative
failures.expected: historical direct authoritative flag equals false
failures.actual: historical property is undefined after capture authority moved to explicit domainAuthority/storedClassification fields
failures.decision: Keep serverless capture non-authoritative by asserting storedClassification=unclassified, storedConfidence=0 and domainAuthority=backend_canonical_only instead of a removed flag.

failures.testName: service worker caches only explicit static allow-list and never caches API/runtime metadata
failures.actual: CACHE_VERSION = hipico-control-v1.13.0-rc3
failures.decision: Do not downgrade the candidate to rc2. Assert release-policy/runtime version parity and the cache safety invariants without pinning a superseded release candidate.

failures.testName: #267 validates password/confirmation and avoids account enumeration copy
failures.expected: source regex requiring an escaped autocomplete=\"new-password\" literal
failures.actual: rendered template already contains autocomplete="new-password" on both password fields
failures.decision: The accessibility/security attribute is present. Make the source contract quote-style agnostic rather than altering valid markup to satisfy an escape-sequence artifact.

failures.testName: release check rejects evidence from another otherwise valid candidate SHA
failures.actual: exit/status 3 because inherited GITHUB_SHA/VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA contaminated the synthetic candidate harness
failures.decision: Isolate synthetic SHA tests from provider CI environment variables. Do not fabricate physical evidence; the real #119 gate remains NOT_READY until device evidence exists.

failures.testName: PR268 exposes exactly one visual authority and official identity
failures.actual: four bounded CSS layers are linked
failures.decision: Reconcile the old PR268 single-file assumption with the current canonical layered style authority; do not reintroduce obsolete CSS or remove required accessibility/operational layers.

failures.testName: service worker cache matches the zero-legacy integrated runtime
failures.actual: current cache is shell-r22-integrated-recovery-299
failures.decision: Cache revision names are implementation revisions, not product invariants. Test atomic namespace retirement and explicit shell contents without pinning an obsolete r4 token.

failures.testName: official source creates only a lab simulation and never an outbound action
failures.actual: equivalent stricter guard rejects non-source OR historySync in one condition
failures.decision: Preserve the stronger no-history-replay simulation guard and assert semantics instead of one formatting/literal form.

failures.testName: Bridge v1.4 observes official source and has a fail-closed LAB-only send path
failures.actual: Bridge version 1.4.2
failures.decision: Keep the patched 1.4.2 Bridge and align the contract with the package/runtime source of truth instead of downgrading to 1.4.0.

failures.testName: Bridge production readiness is authenticated, persistent and source-send closed
failures.actual: MIN_BRIDGE_TOKEN_LENGTH delegates to MIN_HIPICO_RUNTIME_SECRET_BYTES
failures.decision: Centralized secret policy is stronger and removes duplicated constants. Assert the canonical minimum and timing-safe validation behavior instead of a duplicated literal.

failures.testName: backend exposes a dedicated executable Hipico test gate
failures.expected: historical package script text contains npm run test:hipico
failures.actual: inspected script expands direct tsx module tests plus observability and does not contain that literal
failures.decision: Verify that the dedicated backend test:hipico script exists and is invoked by the Hípico QA pipeline; do not require a self-referential literal inside a different script.

failures.testName: #118 canonical policy matches every committed runtime version declaration
failures.actual: release policy 1.13.0-rc2 while build-info/runtime are rc3
failures.decision: This is real release drift. Align the canonical release policy and Android wrapper to rc3 while preserving signing/promotion fail-closed gates.

failures.testName: #118 release gate executes deterministically and writes SHA-bound evidence
failures.expected: release gate can validate one coherent rc3 candidate
failures.actual: RELEASE_BLOCKED: build-info 1.13.0-rc3 != policy 1.13.0-rc2
failures.decision: Fix the same canonical release-version drift rather than bypassing the release gate. The gate must continue to reject mixed candidate metadata.

failures.testName: Control Hípico has an enforced CSP independent from the repo-wide report-only policy
failures.expected: scoped Control Hipico production security headers are present in the deployed frontend configuration
failures.actual: scoped headers are missing from the frontend Vercel configuration used by the project
failures.decision: Apply the Hípico enforced CSP and related scoped headers to frontend/vercel.json, not only the repo-root config, so deployment topology cannot weaken browser security.

failures.testName: Control Hípico reduces browser permissions and cross-origin leakage without changing ContaGest headers
failures.expected: Referrer-Policy no-referrer plus restrictive Hípico browser headers
failures.actual: Referrer-Policy is empty on the effective frontend deployment config
failures.decision: Restore no-referrer, restricted Permissions-Policy and cross-origin containment on the actual frontend deployment configuration while keeping ERP-wide headers unchanged.

failures.testName: security review source contract can import canonical UI primitives under Node
failures.expected: ui.js imports in the source-contract runner without browser globals
failures.actual: ReferenceError: MutationObserver is not defined at ui.js:124
failures.decision: Guard browser-only observers/document/window setup so pure UI helpers stay importable and testable under Node without weakening browser behavior.

failures.testName: group bridge validates types, timestamps, quoted ids and pinned source before persistence
failures.expected: legacy fixture accepted with null validation error
failures.actual: missing_required_field
failures.decision: The Bridge contract now requires behavior-changing identity fields explicitly. Keep the strict schema and update the fixture; do not restore permissive defaults.

failures.testName: omitted group bridge role is canonical source across validation, persistence and lab shadow flow
failures.expected: omitted channelRole is accepted as source
failures.actual: missing_required_field
failures.decision: Implicit SOURCE identity is unsafe. Require channelRole/channel identity explicitly and retain fail-closed validation across serverless and desktop Bridge paths.

failures.testName: serverless bridge identity is mandatory and client channel aliases cannot split the canonical source
failures.actual: missing_required_field is returned first for an incomplete strict payload
failures.decision: Complete the fixture before testing configuration identity errors. Preserve validation ordering so malformed payloads cannot reach identity/persistence logic.

failures.testName: mobile controls preserve the 44px interaction contract
failures.actual: @media (max-width: 900px), (pointer: coarse) with 44px control targets
failures.decision: The broader breakpoint/coarse-pointer rule protects more touch devices. Assert the 44px interaction invariant and supported mobile range rather than the obsolete 780px literal.

failures.testName: Control Hípico loads exactly one canonical stylesheet on app and recovery surfaces
failures.actual: app.css plus three bounded accessibility/operational layers
failures.decision: Reconcile #266 with the current layered authority and ensure both app/recovery load the same approved ordered set; do not revive historical override stylesheets.

failures.testName: service worker caches only canonical CSS plus integrated modules
failures.actual: current shell token shell-r22-integrated-recovery-299
failures.decision: Keep atomic cache revisioning and complete canonical asset coverage; stop treating a historical cache suffix as a product requirement.

failures.testName: recovered runtime is hash-pinned and path traversal protected
failures.actual: ENOENT because rc1 runtime path is no longer the candidate runtime
failures.decision: Resolve the runtime manifest through the canonical release policy/current candidate rather than pinning deleted rc1, while retaining hash and traversal checks.

failures.testName: webhook raw body is captured before browser CSRF while operator route has auth rate limit
failures.actual: app.ts owns raw-body capture/mount ordering while signature validation is correctly encapsulated in the webhook security route/module
failures.decision: Keep signature verification in the webhook security boundary and raw-body lifecycle in app.ts. Test both owners and their ordering instead of duplicating signature knowledge into app.ts.

failures.testName: legacy Control Hipico URL redirects to its independent PWA
failures.actual: effective Vercel route set did not contain the required redirect in the tested deployment configuration
failures.decision: Restore the legacy redirect in the Vercel configuration that actually builds the frontend and keep it ordered before catch-all SPA routing; mirror the security/redirect contract across deployment configs.
